title: Reefer Cargo Services: Admission of a Reefer Service Order
content:
This page sets out what must be true of the booking, the tier and the requested carrying settings before a Reefer Cargo Services order can be taken for a container. Every point is judged from the line's booking and service records as they stand before the order is placed, not from the caller's description of the shipment.

## Clause

A reefer service can be ordered only against a booking whose cargo type is reefer and whose booking status is either requested or confirmed. The booking's equipment type has to be one the chosen tier uses, and its trade lane one on which the tier is offered. The commodity has to appear on the tier's list of goods, except on a tier whose list covers any temperature-controlled cargo. The requested carrying settings must sit within the tier's limits:

- the set point lies between the tier's coldest and warmest accepted temperatures, both limits included;
- a ventilation value greater than zero is accepted only on a tier that offers fresh-air ventilation, and no higher than that tier's ventilation maximum;
- a humidity set point greater than zero is accepted only on a tier that offers dehumidification, and within that tier's lowest and highest humidity set points;
- the oxygen set point lies between the tier's lowest and highest oxygen figures, and the carbon dioxide set point does not exceed the tier's carbon dioxide ceiling.

## Admission checklist

| Point examined | Where it is read | Satisfied when |
|---|---|---|
| Cargo type | booking record | reefer |
| Booking status | booking record | requested or confirmed |
| Equipment | booking record | among the tier's reefer equipment |
| Trade lane | booking record | among the tier's lanes |
| Commodity | the order | on the tier's list, or the tier takes any temperature-controlled cargo |
| Set point | the order | within the tier's temperature band, limits included |
| Ventilation | the order | zero, or a tier with ventilation and not above its maximum |
| Humidity | the order | zero, or a tier with dehumidification and within its humidity limits |
| Oxygen and carbon dioxide | the order | oxygen within the tier's range; carbon dioxide not above its ceiling |

## Hypothetical cases

Suppose, for illustration only, a tier whose temperature band ran from 0.0 °C to 10.0 °C, with no ventilation and no dehumidification.

- A booking with cargo type general cannot take the order, whatever the settings.
- A reefer booking whose status reads equipment released is neither requested nor confirmed, so the order cannot be taken against it.
- A set point of exactly 10.0 °C is inside the band, the warmest limit being included; 10.1 °C is outside it.
- A request for 50 cubic metres per hour of fresh air is refused on this tier, which offers no ventilation; a ventilation value of zero raises no objection.
- A humidity set point of 80 percent is refused on this tier, which offers no dehumidification.
